summary: A free Friday-night outdoor square dance series on the Robbinsville, NC courthouse square, run by Graham County Travel and Tourism as a summer tourism draw for locals and visitors (May-August, with two America 250 marquee dates). Both listings describe a 'mix of returning favorites and new performers' -- i.e. rotating callers/bands booked by the tourism office -- with no mention of a dancer membership, club, sign-up, or dues; the recurring elements are the host organization and the performer lineup, not a fixed community of attendees.

evidence.note: Organizer is Graham County Travel and Tourism; description frames it as 'the beloved Friday tradition' returning for an expanded May 15-Aug 28 season, aimed at 'locals and visitors alike.'
Both listings say the series features 'a mix of returning favorites and new performers,' language describing rotating callers/musical acts rather than a returning body of dancers.

No membership language (no 'join', 'members', dues, sign-up form) or mention of a dance club, Facebook group, or organizing community appears in either listing; tags are generic (Dance, Community, Outdoors, All Ages, Summer Series).

Graham County Travel's site lists other seasonal attractions (Cheoah River Release, Harvest Festival) but has no page or mention of Dancing on the Square, so there is no independent group website, Facebook page, or club presence to point to.
